name: PrivateBin
description: A minimalist, open-source online pastebin where the server has zero knowledge of pasted data.

connection.title: Open PrivateBin
connection.description: Your zero-knowledge encrypted pastebin is ready.

features.title: Zero-Knowledge Encryption
features.description: Content is encrypted and decrypted directly inside the web browser before sending.

features.title: Persistent Data
features.description: Encrypted paste blobs remain stored safely across updates in the privatebin_data volume.
